_doc: Golden queries for offline retrieval evaluation. 'relevant' is a set of attribute rules; a boot is relevant if it matches ALL of them. Defining relevance by rules (not hand-picked ids) keeps the set valid if the catalog is regenerated.

queries.query: waterproof hiking boots for muddy trails
cowboy boots with pointed toe for riding
slip-on boots with elastic sides for the office
rubber boots for gardening in the rain
logger boots with tall heel for forestry
